concerns.text: T031 instructs sweeping 'a range of low to high values' generically, violating FR-005 and SC-003 which explicitly mandate the specific threshold set {50, 100, 150} K/s. This semantic weakening risks unverifiable success criteria.

T024 describes comparing RF RMSE against the null model but omits the explicit instruction to perform the two-sided t-test and fail the build if p >= 0.05. This drops the acceptance criterion from SC-002, making the success condition unverifiable.

T032 hardcodes an error condition for RMSE variance >= 5%, whereas SC-003 specifies a tolerance of <10% for RMSE variance. This contradicts the spec's acceptance criterion and risks false negatives on valid results.

T030a introduces a conditional re-training path (if collinearity > 0.8) that alters the model artifact. This creates a branching output schema not accounted for in the spec's 'Single Source of Truth' (Constitution Principle IV) or the fixed ModelMetrics schema in T023, violating data hygiene and traceability constraints.
